summary: Robin Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 9, 2026 press release disclosing that it participated as an investor in the private placement of Volare Shipping Ltd., a newly established shipping company listed on Euronext Growth Oslo Børs. Robin purchased 90,000 shares at the offering price of NOK 154 per share, adding VLCC-segment exposure without acquiring control or a meaningful stake. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is a routine investment disclosure rather than a special situation; watch for subsequent disclosure if the position is material to the balance sheet or expanded.
